title: Fall Commencement
seo_title: Fall Commencement at Great Southern Bank Arena, Dec 11
description: Missouri State University holds its Fall Commencement ceremonies at Great Southern Bank Arena, 901 S. National Ave. in Springfield, MO, on Friday, December 11, 2026. The 10 am ceremony covers the Darr College of Agriculture, College of Business, College of Natural and Applied Sciences, and Interdisciplinary Academic Programs, and the 1:30 pm ceremony covers the McQueary College of Health and Human Services, Reynolds College of Arts, Social Sciences, and Humanities, and College of Education. No ticket is required, doors open 90 minutes before each ceremony, and only clear bags are permitted in the arena.
